entries.proposition: DESIGN AND SYSTEM: 135 Caucasian pregnant women, 37 normal glucose tolerance and 98 GDM, third-trimester sampling; the only human glycaemia-state measurement of the WWOX/HIF1A transcript pair, in blood leukocytes, not in any neural or pancreatic tissue.
entries.snippet: A total of 135 Caucasian pregnant women consisted of 37 women with normal glucose tolerance (NGT) and 98 women with GDM were enrolled
entries.anchor: Methods, Study participants

entries.proposition: READOUT: whole-leukocyte total RNA after red-cell lysis; the readout is mRNA only (RT-qPCR), a mixed white-cell population, no protein, no activity, no metabolite.
entries.snippet: Total RNA was isolated from leukocytes using a commercially available TRI Reagent
entries.anchor: Methods, Leukocytes separation and RNA extraction

entries.proposition: WWOX itself is only marginally lower in GDM: the paper calls it a tendency at p about 0.04, while the stated fold changes are 1.4 for WWOX against 3.8 for HIF1A. The headline axis shift is carried by HIF1A.
entries.snippet: There was also a tendency for lower leukocyte WWOX expression in the women with GDM vs the controls with NGT
entries.anchor: Results, Gene expression studies during and after pregnancy

entries.proposition: Fold changes as stated: WWOX 1.4-fold down, HIF1A 3.8-fold up, ratio about 6.5-fold down.
entries.snippet: as evidenced by an 1.4- fold decrease for WWOX and a 3.8-fold increase for HIF1A in the diabetic patients
entries.anchor: Results, Gene expression studies during and after pregnancy

entries.proposition: Figure 2A: the WWOX boxplots of GDM and NGT overlap almost entirely; the medians sit near 1 and 1.3 and the NGT upper quartile is much wider; one asterisk only. Figure 2B: HIF1A is clearly higher in GDM (three asterisks). Panel L, the ratio, has most of its spread in a few NGT outliers (axis to 300).
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2, twelve boxplots: WWOX (A, one asterisk), HIF1A (B, three asterisks), SLC2A1, SLC2A4, HK2 (E, NS), PKM2, PFK, LDHA, NFKB1, CTNNB1, DVL2, WWOX/HIF1A ratio (L), GDM left and NGT right in each.
entries.anchor: Figure 2 panels A, B and L, native JPEG

experimental_context.genotype: WWOX untouched, natural variation of expression

entries.proposition: HK2, the first rate-limiting glycolytic step and a canonical HIF1A target, is unchanged between GDM and NGT; the HIF1A-induced programme is therefore partial.
entries.snippet: the leukocyte HK2 transcript level remained unchanged between the two groups
entries.anchor: Results, Gene expression studies during and after pregnancy

entries.proposition: In the GDM group the WWOX and HIF1A transcripts are not correlated with each other (rho -0.05, no asterisk), and WWOX has no correlation with HK2, PKM2 or SLC2A1 (rho -0.07, -0.06, 0.04); only PFK reaches a single asterisk (-0.22). The strong correlations of the ratio with HIF1A (-0.79) and with the glycolytic genes are the arithmetic of a ratio with HIF1A in its denominator.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4, triangular Spearman matrix over WWOX, HIF1A, WWOX.HIF1A, SLC2A1, SLC2A4, HK2, PKM2, PFK, LDHA, NFKB1, DVL2, CTNNB1 in the GDM group; cell values and asterisks printed in the cells.
entries.anchor: Figure 4, GDM group Spearman matrix, native JPEG
entries.found_or_sought: sought: the selection row asked whether the ratio carries information beyond HIF1A

entries.proposition: The text builds the axis argument on correlations of the ratio, with HIF1A-induced genes, stated as negative and significant.
entries.snippet: In the patients with GDM, many correlations were found between WWOX/HIF1A ratio and other genes
entries.anchor: Results, Gene expression correlations

entries.proposition: In the NGT group WWOX correlates positively, not negatively, with PFK (0.30) and LDHA (0.32), the glycolytic genes the axis model says WWOX should restrain; WWOX vs HIF1A rho is -0.12, again not significant.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5, triangular Spearman matrix over the same twelve variables in the NGT group.
entries.anchor: Figure 5, NGT group Spearman matrix, native JPEG

entries.proposition: In normal pregnancy more insulin and more insulin resistance go with HIGHER WWOX expression (the direction opposite to loss of WWOX causing insulin resistance); in GDM neither WWOX nor the ratio correlates with any metabolic parameter.
entries.snippet: In the NGT group, insulin and HOMA-IR index positively associated with WWOX expression
entries.anchor: Results, Correlations between maternal metabolic parameters and the expression of WWOX/HIF-related genes

entries.proposition: The comparison groups differ in age and, unexpectedly, GDM women have LOWER HbA1c than NGT women, so glycaemic-state confounding of the transcript differences is not excluded by the clinical data.
entries.snippet: maternal HbA1c level was significantly lower in the GDM group than NGT controls
entries.anchor: Results, Clinical and biochemical characteristics

entries.proposition: The reported HbA1c correlates, in GDM only, with HIF1A, HK2, PFK and SLC2A1 and inversely with LDHA.
entries.snippet: only HbA1C correlated significantly and positively with HIF1A
entries.anchor: Results, Correlations between maternal metabolic parameters and the expression of WWOX/HIF-related genes

entries.proposition: FIGURE CONTRADICTS TEXT in two printed statistics. Panel C prints R 0.35 and p 0.0003 where the text gives p 0.004 for HK2; panel E prints R -0.22 and p 0.036 for LDHA where the text gives R -0.27 and p 0.010 (Table S1 agrees with the text). HbA1c spans only about 4.3 to 6.1 percent and the positive slopes are visibly carried by a few high-expression points.
